plan.intent:
Build the official VibeServe marketing website. VibeServe is an AI-powered
multi-agent coding system that takes a natural language intent and produces
production-ready code through a 7-step pipeline: architect, code, review,
verify, iterate, test, deploy.

The site needs:
- Hero section: headline, subheadline, primary CTA ("Get Started"), secondary CTA ("View Docs")
- Features section: 3 cards covering pipeline transparency, WCAG AAA enforcement, multi-provider LLM support
- How it works: visual 7-step pipeline diagram
- Footer: GitHub link, PyPI link, license badge

Stack: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
Must pass WCAG AA minimum, AAA preferred

decisions.title: Pipeline Transparency
decisions.context: The VibeServe pipeline is transparent and explainable.
alternatives: Provide detailed explanations of each step in the pipeline
Use visualizations to illustrate the pipeline's functionality
decisions.rationale: Transparency is crucial for trust and adoption.

decisions.title: WCAG AAA Enforcement
decisions.context: The VibeServe website meets WCAG AA minimum and AAA preferred standards.
decisions.rationale: Accessibility is essential for all users.

decisions.title: Multi-Provider LLM Support
decisions.context: The VibeServe platform supports multiple Large Language Models (LLMs).
alternatives: Implement additional support for specific use cases

pipeline.description: Define the architecture of the VibeServe system.
Write production-ready code using the selected programming language and tools.
Review and refine the code for quality, security, and performance.
Verify that the code meets the required specifications and standards.
Iterate on the code to improve its functionality and usability.
Test the code thoroughly to ensure it works as expected.
Deploy the final version of the VibeServe system to production.
